html:
A Hunkpapa Lakota leader and holy man who led his people in resisting the United States on the northern Great Plains. He was born around 1831 in what is now South Dakota.

He made his name as a warrior against rival peoples and then against the US Army in the 1860s. He refused to sign treaties or move onto reservations. In 1876, when the US tried to force the Lakota off the Black Hills after gold was found there, he was the leading figure among the Lakota and Cheyenne camped on the Little Bighorn. Before the battle he had a vision of soldiers falling into camp. At the Battle of the Little Bighorn they destroyed Custer's command.

Hunted afterward, he led his band to Canada. With the bison gone and his people starving, he surrendered in 1881. For a season he toured with Buffalo Bill's Wild West show. In 1890, during the fear over the Ghost Dance, Indian agency police came to arrest him at Standing Rock, and he was shot dead. Two weeks later came the massacre at Wounded Knee.
